SPEED.interpretation: Service flow is not keeping up with demand at some moments - seating, order-taking, kitchen ticket times or pickup hand-off.
SPEED.action: Find the bottleneck first (host stand vs kitchen ticket times vs pickup shelf) using a two-week time log at peak services; give honest wait quotes at seating and for pickup; add an expo/floater on the busiest shifts; keep takeout and dine-in tickets from blocking each other.
SPEED.kpi: Median and 90th-percentile order-to-table time; % tickets over 25 minutes; quoted vs actual pickup time; speed/waiting complaint rate per 100 reviews.

STAFF.interpretation: Guest-facing behaviour is inconsistent - attentiveness, tone and check-backs vary by shift or person.
STAFF.action: Set 3-4 visible service standards (greet within 2 minutes, check back after first bites, refills, friendly close); coach using real review quotes; size sections so servers can check back; recognise staff who are praised by name.
STAFF.kpi: Staff/service negative mention rate; % reviews praising staff by name; standards checklist on a monthly mystery visit.

FOOD.interpretation: Some dishes are not meeting taste or quality expectations (seasoning, consistency, authenticity).
FOOD.action: List the dishes named in negative reviews; standardise recipes and seasoning with a tasting check at the pass; fix or remove the 2-3 weakest dishes; spot-check consistency across shifts and cooks.
FOOD.kpi: Food & drink negative mention rate; complaints per named dish; Google food sub-rating.

FRESH.interpretation: Execution at the pass is slipping - food arriving cold, dry, soggy or over/under-cooked, often at peak times or in takeout.
FRESH.action: Set hold-time limits and pass checks for temperature and doneness; cook proteins to order; use vented packaging for fried items in takeout; review fryer oil and reheating practices.
FRESH.kpi: Temperature/doneness complaint rate; remake rate; % takeout reviews mentioning cold or soggy food.

PORT.interpretation: Portions are seen as small or inconsistent for the price.
PORT.action: Spec portions by weight (scoops, scales, plating photos); audit takeout portions against dine-in; if portions change for cost reasons, say so on the menu rather than shrinking silently.
PORT.kpi: Portion complaint rate; plate-weight variance in spot checks; price & value sentiment.

PRICE.interpretation: Value perception is weak relative to quality and portion, or a pricing policy feels unfair.
PRICE.action: Benchmark core dish prices against the peer group; anchor value with lunch specials, combos or happy hour; make policies (lunch cut-off times, extras, surcharges) explicit on the menu before ordering.
PRICE.kpi: Price & value negative mention rate; share of reviews praising value; average spend per guest.

ACC.interpretation: Orders or bills go wrong - missing items, wrong dishes, ignored special requests or billing errors.
ACC.action: Read orders back at the counter and on the phone; make modifiers prominent on tickets; check every bag and plate against the ticket before hand-off; review bills before presenting them.
ACC.kpi: Order error rate (% tickets remade or refunded); missing-item complaints per 100 takeout orders; billing corrections per week.

AMB.interpretation: The physical environment - noise, temperature, comfort or upkeep - takes away from the visit.
AMB.action: Walk the room at peak and note noise, temperature, lighting and comfort; fix quick wins (music volume, drafts, ventilation, seating); plan a refresh if the space is described as dated.
AMB.kpi: Ambience negative mention rate; Google atmosphere sub-rating.

CLEAN.interpretation: Customers report cleanliness or hygiene lapses (washrooms, tables, food handling).
CLEAN.action: Introduce an hourly washroom/table checklist with sign-off; verify glove and handwashing practice at the line; set a deep-clean schedule; manager walk-through before each peak.
CLEAN.kpi: Cleanliness & hygiene complaint rate (target: zero); checklist completion %; public health inspection results.

LOC.interpretation: Access friction (parking, finding the entrance) shapes the visit before it starts.
LOC.action: Put parking and entrance directions on the Google listing, website and confirmation messages; explore an arrangement with a nearby lot; improve street signage.
LOC.kpi: Location/parking complaint rate; direction requests on the Google listing.

DELIV.interpretation: The off-premise experience (packaging, pickup hand-off, online or third-party orders) underperforms.
DELIV.action: Audit packaging for travel (venting, sealing, separating sauces); create a pickup shelf and hand-off routine; keep third-party app menus, prices and prep times in sync with the kitchen.
DELIV.kpi: Takeout & delivery negative mention rate; third-party app rating; % pickups ready at the quoted time.

DIET.interpretation: Guests with dietary needs do not trust the options or how requests are handled.
DIET.action: Mark V/VG/GF and major allergens on the menu; train staff on an allergen protocol (ask, confirm with kitchen, prevent cross-contact); give one clear process for special requests.
DIET.kpi: Dietary negative mention rate; share of dietary mentions that are positive.

COMPL.interpretation: When something goes wrong, recovery is weak - slow fixes, unanswered calls or defensive replies.
COMPL.action: Adopt a short recovery routine (acknowledge, apologise, fix or comp, follow up); answer phones and messages at peak; reply to negative Google reviews within 48 hours, factually and without arguing.
COMPL.kpi: % negative reviews with an owner reply; reply time; complaint-handling negative mention rate.

MENU.interpretation: Range or availability disappoints - sold-out items or too few options.
MENU.action: Track 86'd items daily and tell guests at seating; review menu breadth against peers; keep online menus current.
MENU.kpi: Stock-outs per week; menu variety complaint rate.
